title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Dolby B metal cassette master > 20-bit SBM2 > CDR (David Gans master) > EAC > SoundForge
source: Set 1 SBD > Dolby B metal cassette master. Set 2  SBD > ? (likely cassette master)

ai_review.summary: A rich sound‑board capture of an early‑80s show, highlighted by a superb “Morning Dew” and solid overall playing.
ai_review.review: The post‑April ’82 soundboard source is praised for its clear, bass‑rich mix that avoids the usual muddiness of the era. The concert delivers a consistently good performance – above‑average for ‘82 – with “Morning Dew” singled out as a highlight, while Phil’s night was mixed and a false start on “Me & My Uncle” adds human charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated above average with standout moments, and recording quality is described as excellent to good; the weighted assessment yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, ambient sound with clear bass; reviewers note it avoids typical early‑80s muffling and has a well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently good throughout with no single section dominating; the set maintains a steady, above‑average energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as great throughout; solid guitar work noted by multiple reviewers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – some feel his playing was off‑night, while others highlight authoritative bass lines and good mix presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as great overall but involved in a jam tension with Phil during the Spanish Jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland noted for strong organ/piano work and well‑represented in the mix.
